text: {"frames":["The fog over the canal smelled of cheese and tomato. On the bottom stair of the Tower sat a pizza, still warm, with {a} slices in all. A small wet note lay on top in a careful hand: whoever eats this must leave the other half for the shadow in the cellar. The stair creaked twice, as if someone was waiting. You must not cut the pizza wrong. How many slices make half of the pizza?","\"Please help me,\" called a small voice from the reeds beside the Tower canal. A little boat had drifted in, and in it sat a locked casket with a pizza beside it. The pizza has {a} slices, and the casket lid will open only when the right share is laid on it. Pim, the lock keeper's boy, sits on the edge of the boat with his cap in his hands. How many slices make half of the pizza, so the lid can open?","\"Mind the step that isn't on the plan,\" whispered Joop from the landing. He held out a wooden board with a pizza on it, {a} slices in all. \"Whoever takes exactly half opens the door up there,\" he said, and pointed at the ceiling, where no door had been yesterday. The board gave a small tap, as if someone was counting underneath. How many slices make half of the pizza?","A smell of hot dough and tomato drifted down the cellar stairs. Something was nibbling in the dark behind the herring barrels, a soft, patient sound. On the shelf lay a pizza with {a} slices, cut neatly by someone who was not there. The nibbling stopped the moment you touched the plate. How many slices make half of the pizza, the half the shadow is owed?","You pull the lever, and the mill turns, though there is no wind at all. The sails swing round and stop over the big round pizza on the millstone, which has {a} slices in all. A bell rings somewhere in the Tower and the wheel will not move again until half of the pizza sits on the blue plate. The miller's cat sits watching you with yellow eyes. How many slices make half of the pizza?"]}
